title: Xu at SemEval-2022 Task 4: Pre-BERT Neural Network Methods vs Post-BERT RoBERTa Approach for Patronizing and Condescending Language Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating text classification models (RoBERTa, LSTM, ANN) on their ability to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) directed at socioeconomically vulnerable communities (e.g., homeless, poor families, in need) using the 'Don't Patronize Me!' dataset.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) directed at immigrants, migrants, and refugees using the 'Don't Patronize Me!' dataset.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) directed at disabled communities using the 'Don't Patronize Me!' dataset.
Evaluating text classification models on their ability to detect patronizing and condescending language (PCL) directed at women using the 'Don't Patronize Me!' dataset.
